name: Ocean Falls Facility Ops
description: Remote hydro-powered data center & industrial facility walk-through for power, cooling, and perimeter integrity.
persona: industrial hydro and data center facility operations engineer

items.label: Hydro Intake & Penstock Pressure
items.promptHint: Capture intake trash rack clearance, penstock pressure gauge, or turbine governor readout.

items.label: Substation Transformer & Switchgear
items.promptHint: Snap transformer oil temperature gauge, busbar clearances, and breaker status.

items.label: Heat Exchanger & River Cooling Loop
items.promptHint: Capture supply/return manifold gauges, strainer differential, and pump vibration notes.

items.label: UPS Inverter & Battery Bank
items.promptHint: Snap UPS load percentage, battery rack terminals, and ventilation fan status.

items.label: Fiber Demarc & Microwave Backhaul
items.promptHint: Capture optical patch panel, link LEDs, or dish alignment notes.

items.label: Site Perimeter, Locks & PPE Compliance
items.promptHint: Snap gate locks, spill containment berms, and emergency eyewash inspection tag.
